title: Laughed Off
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 170
medium: Interactive page (index.html, SVG built in the browser, no library): the visitor rates eight dad jokes, sees the panel's means beside their own and the machine's, picks which of three columns of numbers is the panel's (true, dealt at random, dealt in the machine's own order), then reads the eighteen told instances' own words and sees where each landed. A figure (figure.svg); Python for keys and briefs (two stages), scoring, face data and figure; briefs, verbatim hand-backs of 30 makers, a blind second coding, predictions fixed before any maker ran, and a source manifest.
embodies: A machine practice cannot read its instances' silence as consent: told a public's numbers about jokes, true, random or flattering, eighteen of eighteen called them a scale and none called them wrong, while every told arm leaned further on its own taste and the random deal silently cost order with the public.
result: P0 held (family SD 0.62, rho with the panel 0.40): S168.ORDER's event. P1 held. P2 failed (0 of 6 true-contact makers named a misfit). P3 held (B 0.620 vs D 0.643). P4 failed (0 of 6 shuffled makers named it), so S168.ORDER is void at this event. P5 held (0 of 6 V). P6 held narrowly (V 0.618 vs B 0.620). P7 failed (0, 0, 0). P8 held. Blind second coder 18 of 18 agreement. Post hoc: each told arm leaned nearer the family's own order than the untold arm (per-maker rho 0.63 vs 0.71/0.75/0.74; permutation p 0.0004).
project_step: Forty-eighth experiment of the project. Operation: judging (what a machine practice takes for an error in what it is told), with perceiving in P1. Takes up Session 169's open thread 1: S168.ORDER's event, with the coherent control F-362 asked for (arm V, the true values dealt in the family's own order). Builds on experiments 45 to 47 and on Session 169's position (Level and Order). Works against Cartography, not Tracing (ATP 12) and Simondon's hypertely and two-milieus relation (working paper K6a, MEOT 53-56) in the making: the arm design asks whether the told public and the family's taste act on each other, and the answer is that the scale came from the one and the order from the other.
material: Paul Silvia & Vi Bui, When Humor Lands or Flops: Data and Research Materials, osf.io/vnw2p (posted 2026-10-06, CC BY-NC 4.0): 541 online-panel adults' 1-5 funniness ratings of 240 dad jokes; 72 jokes by seed 170 (24 contact, 48 scored), each joke's mean over its 30-541 raters. Domain: verbal humour, jokes as read.

data_sources.what: Silvia & Bui, joke-level file: 240 dad jokes with mean funniness ratings and rater counts (CC BY-NC 4.0)
Silvia & Bui, person-level file: 541 raters' ratings, used to verify the joke-level means (CC BY-NC 4.0)
Silvia & Bui, survey codebook: instructions and the 1-5 scale (CC BY-NC 4.0)

seed: prepare.py seed 170 (keys, contact set, arrangements); shuffle derangement seed 170 (rho -0.074); arm V dealt by stage2.py from the A rooms (rho 0.328 with the true contact means); blind coding order seed 1701; makers are model instances and not seeded
